inspection_standard: HUD National Standards for the Physical Inspection of Real Estate (NSPIRE)

lead_paint_compliance.standard: 24 CFR Part 35 / HUD Lead Safe Housing Rule
lead_paint_compliance.action_required: Visual paint inspection required; zero chipping, cracking, or peeling on interior and exterior friction surfaces.

nspire_checklist.nspire_rule: Operable sealed 10-year battery or hardwired smoke alarms on every level, inside each bedroom, and outside sleeping areas.
Installed within 10 feet of every bedroom in homes with fuel-burning appliances or attached garages (MN Statute 299F.51).
GFCI protection operational on all outlets within 6 feet of sinks, water sources, exterior receptacles, and bathrooms.
No open knockouts or exposed wiring; dead-front panel cover tightly fastened.
Windows in designated bedrooms must open smoothly, hold open without props, and latch securely.
Temperature/Pressure Relief (TPR) valve installed with rigid discharge pipe terminating within 6 inches of floor.
Weatherstripped, weather-tight, and equipped with functioning single-cylinder deadbolt (no double-keyed locks).
Capable of maintaining continuous minimum 68°F indoor temperature during heating season without unvented space heaters.
